code_usage_tracer.summary: tenant_id key removed from create_payment_event return dict; only caller is test that never consumes the removed key.

adrs_evaluated.title: Multi-Tenant Payment Isolation
invariants_found: Every payment authorization event MUST include the originating tenant_id in its root payload for multi-tenant billing isolation and regulatory compliance.
adrs_evaluated.violated_by: Removal of 'tenant_id' key from return dict in create_payment_event() function

adr_invariant_checker.summary: The removal of tenant_id from the payment event payload directly violates ADR-042's mandatory requirement for multi-tenant payment isolation.

test_assertion_auditor.coverage_gap: No assertion checks for the 'tenant_id' key in the returned dict. The removal of 'tenant_id' from the payload is completely invisible to the test suite; all three assertions target unrelated keys ('payment_id', 'amount') or a null-check.
test_assertion_auditor.summary: The sole test function never asserts 'tenant_id', producing a FALSE GREEN — pytest passes 1/1 even though the ADR-mandated 'tenant_id' field has been silently dropped from the payment event payload.

findings.description: tenant_id key removed from payment event return payload, directly violating ADR-042 MUST requirement for multi-tenant billing isolation.
findings.remediation: Restore 'tenant_id': tenant_id to the return dict in create_payment_event.

findings.description: Test suite produces a FALSE GREEN — pytest passes with 1/1 despite the ADR contract being broken because no assertion covers tenant_id.

recommendation: BLOCK this change. Two CRITICAL findings: (1) direct ADR-042 violation — tenant_id silently removed from payment event payload; (2) test suite false green — no test asserts tenant_id, masking the regression entirely.
